investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Orbpoint Freight (freight and logistics); Platform: on-premises data center DC-North, server range 10.205.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster orbpoi-prod (kubeadm); rate-engine pods run with 2 GiB memory limits; deployments are canary releases with automated analysis; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
